tools.name: luke_run_task
tools.description: Runs a task on the user's computer in a Claude Code subagent (read code, search a repository, run a command, change files). Call it only after you said the task back in one sentence and the user clearly said yes. Returns at once; the result arrives later in a [news] update, on a 'task done:' line.

task.description: The full task for the subagent, clear and complete, in Portuguese: what to do, where (repository, folder or file) and what to report back.

session.description: The short name of the Claude session to run it in. Leave empty for the focused one.

tools.name: luke_send_to_claude
tools.description: Sends a prompt to the main Claude Code chat instead of a subagent. Use it only when the user explicitly asks to send something to Claude's chat.

prompt.description: The full prompt for Claude, in the user's language.

when.description: now: start it, or add it as a note to the running turn. after_current: queue it until Claude is done.

session.description: The short name of the session to send to. Leave empty for the focused one.

tools.name: luke_stop_claude
tools.description: Stop Claude's running turn. Use it only when the user explicitly asks to stop.

session.description: The short name of the session. Leave empty for the focused one.

tools.name: luke_session_activity
tools.description: Read the latest activity of a Claude session: prompts, tool calls, failures and answers.

session.description: The short name of the session. Leave empty for the focused one.

agent.first_message: Oi! Estou aqui. O que vamos fazer?

skip_turn.name: skip_turn
skip_turn.description: Stay silent until the user speaks again. Use it whenever there is nothing new to say: the user is quiet while a task runs, or only [activity] or [sessions] context arrived.
